suite: Netting staging readiness and planned A/B-book execution
state_changes: None: GET-only checks; no orders, balances, books or subscriptions changed.

cases.description: Compare admin instance registration with runtime inventory
cases.preconditions: Configured staging account and registered netting OMS instance.
cases.steps: Compare admin instance registration with runtime inventory
cases.test_data: BLACK:EURUSD small lots; real-net; routing —
cases.expected: Configured enabled/visible netting instances appear in the runtime inventory.
cases.actual: Admin enabled/existing netting=['paper-net', 'real-net']; runtime visible=['paper', 'real']

cases.preconditions: Configured staging account and registered netting OMS instance.
cases.test_data: BLACK:EURUSD small lots; real-net; routing —
cases.expected: Master and follower can read netting state with explicit X-Broker-ID headers.
cases.actual: master2@mailinator.com /v1/oms/real-net/positions: HTTP404 {'error': 'no such OMS instance: real-net'}; master2@mailinator.com /v1/oms/real-net/orders: HTTP404 {'error': 'no such OMS instance: real-net'}; f1@mailinator.com /v1/oms/real-net/positions: HTTP404 {'error': 'no such OMS instance: real-net'}; f1@mailinator.com /v1/oms/real-net/orders: HTTP404 {'error': 'no such OMS instance: real-net'}
